headword: {心療内科|しんりょうないか}
gloss: psychosomatic medicine; psychosomatic internal medicine department

definitions.gloss: psychosomatic medicine department; clinic for stress-related physical symptoms
definitions.explanation: A medical specialty that treats physical symptoms — stomach pain, headaches, insomnia, palpitations — believed to be caused or worsened by psychological stress. Patients often go there when tests at an ordinary internal medicine clinic find nothing wrong.

examples.japanese: {心療内科|しんりょうないか}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I've been going to a psychosomatic medicine clinic.

examples.japanese: {胃|い}の{不調|ふちょう}が{続|つづ}き、{心療内科|しんりょうないか}を{受診|じゅしん}した。
examples.english: My stomach trouble kept up, so I saw a psychosomatic medicine specialist.

examples.japanese: ストレスが{原因|げんいん}かもしれないと{言|い}われ、{心療内科|しんりょうないか}を{紹介|しょうかい}された。
examples.english: I was told stress might be the cause, and was referred to a psychosomatic medicine department.

notes:
Often the least intimidating door into mental health care in Japan, since the presenting complaint is a physical one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心療内科|しんりょうないか}を{受診|じゅしん}する: to see a psychosomatic medicine doctor
- {心療内科|しんりょうないか}に{通|かよ}う: to attend such a clinic regularly
- {心療内科|しんりょうないか}を{紹介|しょうかい}される: to be referred to one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精神科|せいしんか}: psychiatry — treats mental illness itself, including conditions requiring hospitalization
- {神経内科|しんけいないか}: neurology — treats diseases of the nerves and brain, not stress reactions
- {内科|ないか}: internal medicine — the general department this one branched off from
